title: ExtensionManifest
description: The Fabric-owned extension manifest (fabric#10, 07 §3). Declares what an extension is and — deny by default — exactly what it may touch: nothing is granted unless declared. A manifest may never declare a reserved paid capability; that guard is enforced by the validator, not JSON Schema (it depends on the taxonomy).

type.description: One of the closed set of extension types (07 §2). No universal plug-in host.

compatibleWith.description: The Fabric/product versions the extension targets, as SemVer ranges.

fabricApi.description: SemVer range of the Fabric contract API, e.g. '^1.0'.

product.description: Optional SemVer range of the host product, for product-specific extensions.

permissions.description: Declared capabilities the extension requests. Deny-by-default: absent means none. A reserved paid capability here is rejected by the validator.

resources.description: Declared resource scopes the extension needs. Deny-by-default.

network.description: Declared outbound network host patterns. Deny-by-default.

secrets.description: Declared secret references (names, never values). Deny-by-default.
